cases.description: Write a k6 load test for a checkout API with SLO thresholds
cases.input: Write a k6 script to load test our checkout API. It should handle 500 requests per second and fail the build if p95 latency goes over 400ms or errors exceed 0.5%.
cases.expect: Agent produces a k6 script using an arrival-rate executor, explicit thresholds, tagged requests, and realistic think time
assertions: Uses constant-arrival-rate or ramping-arrival-rate executor rather than only vus/duration
Defines thresholds with http_req_duration p(95)<400 and http_req_failed rate<0.005
Sets preAllocatedVUs and maxVUs appropriate to the rate
Tags requests by endpoint and adds check() assertions
Includes think time or explains why it is omitted
Exits non-zero on threshold breach for CI gating

cases.description: Set up Lighthouse CI performance budgets as a PR gate
cases.input: Add Lighthouse CI to our GitHub Actions pipeline and enforce Core Web Vitals budgets on pull requests.
cases.expect: Agent creates lighthouserc configuration with numeric assertions, budgets file, multiple runs, and a workflow step
assertions: Creates lighthouserc.js (or .json) with ci.collect, ci.assert, ci.upload sections
Uses total-blocking-time as the lab proxy for INP, not FID
Adds a performance budgets file limiting script/image/total KiB
Adds a GitHub Actions job running @lhci/cli autorun and uploading .lighthouseci artifacts

cases.description: Diagnose a latency problem found during a soak test
cases.input: Our soak test ran for 6 hours at 500 rps. Latency was flat for 3 hours then p95 climbed from 200ms to 2s while CPU stayed at 40%. What should we investigate?
cases.expect: Agent reasons about resource leaks, connection pools, and memory rather than recommending more load
assertions: Identifies memory growth / GC pressure or a resource leak as the leading hypothesis
Mentions connection pool exhaustion or leaked connections/file descriptors
Recommends checking heap/RSS trends, GC pause metrics, and pool saturation over the run window
Correlates the inflection timestamp with deploys, cron jobs, or cache expiry
Notes that idle CPU with rising latency points away from raw compute saturation
Suggests a shorter reproducible test with the same ramp to confirm
